# Synthetic fixtures

These small fixtures were written for this repository. They contain no copied
production data, personal data, credentials, or third-party copyrighted
content. They may be redistributed under the repository's MIT license.

The textual corpus intentionally includes plain text, Markdown, HTML, RFC 5322
email-shaped text, and Python source so the Phase 2 connector and extractor path
exercises every dependency-free textual input kind.
